texts.preamble: Nirmal Agarwal S/O Late Hulash Chand ... vs State Of Rajasthan (2025:Rj-Jp:34329) on 28 August, 2025 Author: Sameer Jain Bench: Sameer Jain [2025:Rj-Jp:34329] High Court Of Judicature For Rajasthan Bench At Jaipur S.B. Civil Writ Petition No. 12951/2025 1. Nirmal Agarwal S/o Late Hulash Chand Agarwal, Owner Of M/s Bhavy Tradingh Company, E-20, Surajpoleanaj Mandi Jaipur- 302003. 2. Raj Solvex Private Limited, 1662 First Floor Chandrawal, Roadsubzi Mandi Delhi- 110007 3. Shubham Enterprises, 69, 3Rd Floor, Bagh Diwar, Fateh Puri, Delhi- 110006. 4. Kwality Oil Private Limited, Katahari Morang, Nepal.
texts.arguments: Learned counsel for the petitioners has submitted that the petitioner has filed the representation dated 08.07.2025 to the designated Officer following under the Chief Medical and Health Officer, Nirmal Agarwal S/O Late Hulash Chand ... vs State Of Rajasthan (2025:Rj-Jp:34329) on 28 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/152713721/ 1 Jaipur-I. It is further submitted that on 17.04.2025, one Food Safety Officer conducted an inspection at the premise of the [2025:RJ-JP:34329] (2 of 3) [CW-12951/2025] petitioner and seized the Refined Soyabean Oil from the premise, qua the same, samples were also drawn and as per report dated 01.05.2025, sample was found to be of sub-standard quality. Learned counsel for the petitioners has further submitted that as per the provisions of Section 47(4) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 an application was filed for release of the seized food article as the same were perishable. Learned counsel for the petitioners has relied upon judgment passed by Hon'ble Apex Court titled as Sunderbhai Ambalal Desai vs State Of Gujarat reported in (2002) 10 SCC 290 and has submitted that no heed was given to the said representation which was duly received in the office on 09.07.2025 and due to the non-action on the said representation, present petition is filed.

Learned counsel for the petitioners has further submitted that as per the provisions of Section 47(4) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 an application was filed for release of the seized food article as the same were perishable. Learned counsel for the petitioners has relied upon judgment passed by Hon'ble Apex Court titled as Sunderbhai Ambalal Desai vs State Of Gujarat reported in (2002) 10 SCC 290 and has submitted that no heed was given to the said representation which was duly received in the office on 09.07.2025 and due to the non-action on the said representation, present petition is filed.
